name: arith_mul
title: Integer multiply and remainder throughput
measures: A multiply-add-remainder hash in a counted loop. Intermediate products exceed int32 (RuneScript widens them; TypeScript numbers are exact below 2^53).
notes: acc * 31 + i exceeds int32 for large acc: RuneScript's generic int widens the intermediate (no error), and only the stored result is checked. ts-checked checks the stored result the same way.
